title: Velocity after baffle collision
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of block A's velocity after the elastic collision with the left barrier as 2 m/s.

title: Heat from ground friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the heat Q generated by friction between plate B and the ground, rounded to two significant figures (0.55 J).

title: Pendulum length
description: Essential: Correctly determines the pendulum length L, matching the reference solution (e.g., 81/16 m or 5.06 m).

title: Energy and kinematics reasoning
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem or kinematics correctly to find the displacement of block A on the rough section or the motion of plate B.

title: Time synchronization condition
description: Important: Uses the condition that the time for block A's return to point O equals half the period of the ball's simple harmonic motion to relate variables.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to find the accelerations of plate B on the ground and during block A's deceleration.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in velocity directions (e.g., for collisions or relative motion) or in work-energy expressions.

title: Friction force confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses or misapplies the friction coefficients (μ₁ for A-B, μ₂ for B-ground) in force or work calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (kg, m, s, J) throughout the calculation without conversion errors.
